responsibility: Declares lightweight analyzer abstractions for symbolic memory extents measured in bytes. It defines symbolic_byte_offset as a wrapper around an svalue and symbolic_byte_range as a start-plus-size range with helpers for dumping, JSON conversion, emptiness and endpoint queries, and tristate intersection testing against region_model constraints, providing a reusable byte-oriented range vocabulary distinct from lower-level bit-range and store-offset types.
same_name_distinction: Declares the symbolic_byte_offset and symbolic_byte_range interfaces used across the analyzer; the companion ranges.cc supplies their algorithms for conversion, formatting, endpoint calculation, and constraint-based intersection.
